source: The MIRA memory port should use SQLite as the local derived index rather than Postgres.
target: The reference MIRA implementation stores memory state in Postgres.
reason: The newer Sprout storage decision replaces the reference implementation choice.

source: The default embedding provider for the port is the local MongoDB mdbr leaf model.
target: The early implementation prompt listed hosted embeddings as the default provider.
reason: The local provider decision replaces the earlier hosted default.

source: There are no legacy Sprout memory users, so migration can be validated with fixtures only.
target: The migration plan assumed existing user memory stores had to be preserved in place.
reason: The no-legacy-users fact replaces the older migration assumption.

source: Subcortical recall is opt-in per agent through explicit configuration.
target: The draft recall design enabled subcortical query expansion for every agent by default.
reason: The opt-in policy replaces the previous default-on behavior.

source: The archivist may write memories only through explicit authorized memory write paths.
target: The archivist draft allowed direct memory creation while composing answers.
reason: The authorization rule replaces direct writes from answer synthesis.

source: The embedding adapter must fail loudly when the local provider is unavailable.
target: The embedding adapter may silently return empty vectors when generation fails.
reason: Fail-loud behavior is incompatible with silent empty-vector fallback.

source: Bus learn signals must route through extraction before any memory is stored.
target: Bus learn signals can be stored directly as raw learn signal descriptions.
reason: Extraction-gated writes contradict raw signal storage.

source: Session collapse should run for terminal failed and timed-out sessions unless aborted.
target: Session collapse should run only for fully successful sessions.
reason: The terminal-run policy includes failures that the success-only policy excludes.

source: Phase 6 quality remains unsatisfied until recorded or live relationship outputs are evaluated.
target: Fixture shape validation alone completes the relationship classifier quality gate.
reason: The quality-gate requirement rejects fixture-only completion.

source: Memory prompts must live as editable prompt files under root prompts.
target: Memory prompts can be embedded only as TypeScript string constants.
reason: File-backed prompts conflict with code-only prompt storage.

source: The user asked to use local embeddings rather than hosted embeddings for MIRA memory.
target: The CodeMira template uses a local embedding model for memory search.
reason: Both memories support local embeddings as the intended approach.

source: JSONL remains the source of truth for memory data in Sprout.
target: The SQLite memory index is rebuildable derived state.
reason: A rebuildable index supports the JSONL source-of-truth rule.

source: Deterministic recall must remain the fast path before any LLM recall expansion.
target: Subcortical recall only augments the query and never replaces deterministic recall.
reason: Both memories preserve deterministic recall as mandatory.

source: Delegated agents should reuse the same surfaced memory block from root recall.
target: The Phase 4 gate proved delegated agents see the root surfaced memories.
reason: The test result confirms the intended delegation behavior.

source: Collapse extraction requires terminal session evidence before writing memories.
target: The collapse process must avoid memories from incomplete session transcripts.
reason: The terminal evidence rule supports the incomplete-transcript guard.

source: The local embedding provider uses MongoDB mdbr leaf ir with 768-dimensional vectors.
target: Sprout uses local embeddings for memory search.
reason: The provider and dimensions make the broader local-embedding choice more specific.

source: The extraction prompt treats segment summaries as non-authoritative context.
target: Memory extraction receives current segment summary context.
reason: The newer memory clarifies how summary context may be used.

source: The relationship classifier excludes extraction_ref because it is system-generated.
target: The relationship classifier labels semantic links between memories.
reason: The exclusion defines the boundary of classifier-owned labels.

source: Archivist memory writes require cited evidence and an explicit write tool call.
target: The archivist can participate in memory maintenance.
reason: The newer memory narrows participation to evidence-backed authorized writes.

source: Bus signal extraction waits for a matching act_end or root session_end event.
target: Bus signal extraction needs an event window before writing memory drafts.
reason: The wait condition specifies when the event window is complete enough.

source: Phase 1 extends the memory schema and storage primitives.
target: Phase 2 adds extraction prompts and extracted memory drafts.
reason: The schema foundation is planned before extraction writes.

source: Phase 2 routes learn memory writes through extraction.
target: Phase 5 teaches the archivist how to answer from memory evidence.
reason: The learn extraction phase comes earlier in the implementation sequence.

source: The local embedding provider must exist before vectors can be indexed in SQLite.
target: The SQLite vector index stores ready embedding vectors for recall.
reason: Embedding generation has to happen before vector indexing.

source: Collapse creates a segment summary before running memory extraction for that segment.
target: Memory extraction receives the current segment summary context.
reason: The summary is produced before it can be supplied to extraction.

source: Link candidate generation runs before relationship classification.
target: The relationship classifier evaluates candidate memory pairs.
reason: Candidate discovery supplies the pairs the classifier labels.

source: The user strongly rejected hidden fallback behavior.
target: The local embedding adapter should throw when embedding generation fails.
reason: The user preference explains why the adapter fails loudly.

source: CodeMira is a useful template but Sprout should not blindly copy every decision.
target: Sprout chose SQLite instead of Postgres for the MIRA memory port.
reason: The template guidance explains the adapted storage choice.

source: There are no legacy Sprout memory users.
target: Migration validation can focus on fixtures instead of production backfills.
reason: The absence of legacy users explains the fixture-focused migration approach.

source: The MIRA memory port is planned as a phase-gated multi-week implementation.
target: Each commit should keep the build passing and receive roborev review.
reason: The long-running plan explains the strict incremental commit discipline.

source: API keys live in the local environment for opt-in model tests.
target: The relationship classifier live eval should be skipped by default unless explicitly enabled.
reason: The environment setup explains why live evaluation can be available but not automatic.

source: Using SQLite as a rebuildable local cache is a Sprout-specific adaptation of the CodeMira approach.
target: The port should use CodeMira style ideas without blindly copying decisions.
reason: The storage choice is an example of selective adaptation.

source: Throwing on local embedding provider failure is an example of the no-fallback rule.
target: The implementation should have no hidden fallbacks.
reason: The adapter behavior is a concrete instance of the broader rule.

source: Keeping memory extraction and archivist prompts as files exemplifies the prompts-as-files guardrail.
target: Memory prompts should not be hidden only inside TypeScript constants.
reason: The prompt placement is a concrete example of the guardrail.

source: Routing bus learn signals through extraction exemplifies preserving the learn pipeline event detection.
target: The implementation must preserve RoutingRule and learn pipeline event detection.
reason: The bus path is a specific case of the broader preservation requirement.

source: Per-agent subcortical recall configuration exemplifies opt-in expansion rather than out-of-scope default behavior.
target: The port should avoid adding out-of-scope features by default.
reason: The opt-in switch is a concrete example of constrained feature scope.

source: The archivist prompt requires cited answers from memory evidence.
target: Segment collapse stores summaries in the memories segments JSONL file.
reason: The memories concern separate archivist answer behavior and collapse storage mechanics.

source: The SQLite derived index can be rebuilt from JSONL memory records.
target: The web UI is implemented with React and a separate TypeScript config.
reason: Storage rebuild behavior does not affect the web UI framework choice.

source: The relationship classifier outputs only a raw JSON object.
target: Bun's test runner uses describe and test blocks.
reason: Classifier response format and test framework structure are independent.

source: Subcortical recall expands recall queries before deterministic lookup.
target: The bootstrap installer validates shell PATH entries.
reason: Recall query expansion does not inform installer PATH validation.

source: The local embedding vector has 768 dimensions.
target: The archivist should not receive surfaced memories as prompt pollution.
reason: Embedding dimensionality and archivist prompt isolation are separate concerns.

source: There are no legacy memory users for this port.
target: The relationship classifier repairs curly quotes in model JSON output.
reason: User migration scope does not change JSON repair behavior.

source: Subagent write permissions are an open authorization question.
target: Memory extraction escapes quotation marks in event evidence.
reason: Write permission policy and prompt escaping are independent implementation details.

source: Commit messages should use conventional commit prefixes.
target: Embedding vectors should not be treated as authoritative JSONL source data.
reason: Commit style policy does not affect memory storage authority.

source: The bus signal buffer trims old session events after extraction.
target: The relationship classifier includes a precedes label for temporal order.
reason: Event buffer maintenance does not determine semantic link labeling.

source: SQLite FTS supports lexical recall over memory text.
target: The root agent may delegate work to named child agents.
reason: Lexical memory indexing and delegation capability are unrelated.

source: The completion report should recommend next steps after implementation.
target: The local embedding provider normalizes vectors before storage.
reason: Reporting workflow does not affect vector normalization.

source: Memory IDs include short identifiers for display.
target: The learn process removes create_memory from the non-memory reasoner tool list.
reason: Identifier presentation and tool availability are separate.

source: Relationship healing may archive stale aliases during consolidation.
target: Session collapse should preserve the original thrown error after cleanup.
reason: Alias maintenance and exception propagation occur in different paths.

source: The memory block renderer includes effective importance scores.
target: The Linear ticket lifecycle moves implementation work to In Dev.
reason: Memory rendering details do not affect Linear workflow state.

source: The classifier eval fixture contains hard null memory pairs.
target: The CLI bootstrap lists remote provider models for configuration.
reason: Evaluation fixture composition and CLI model listing are independent.
